extDescription.message: On-device scam & phishing protection: warns you, spots brand look-alikes, checks messages. Nothing leaves your device.

popupPausedSummary.message: Protection is paused — turn it on to resume.

popupNotHttp.message: Browser pages and the web store aren't scanned.

popupDangerSummary.message: Don't enter passwords or card details here.

popupSuspiciousSummary.message: Take care before typing anything here.

checkMessageHint.message: Paste a suspicious SMS, WhatsApp or email text, or a link. Checked entirely on your device.

checkMessagePlaceholder.message: Paste the message or link here…

msgSafe.message: Looks safe — no scam signals found

runsOnDevice.message: Runs on your device · nothing leaves your browser

protectionLead.message: Everything here runs on your device. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you turn on community reporting at the bottom.

protectionOnHint.message: Scans pages for scams and warns you. Turn off to pause everything.

grpScamsHint.message: Blocking known-bad sites and catching new phishing on your device.

grpPopupsHint.message: Fake virus alerts, screen-lockers and clipboard hijacks.

grpShoppingHint.message: Spots fake online shops and where search ads really go.

grpPrivacyHint.message: Catches sites that leak your details or track your device — all on your device.

optBlockKnownHint.message: Stops pages on the daily-updated threat list before they load.

optPageAnalysisHint.message: Reads the page's wording, layout and icons on your device to catch scams that aren't on any list yet.

optClickfixHint.message: Stops pages that tell you to press Win+R and paste a command (ClickFix malware).

optFakeupdateHint.message: Blocks pages pretending your browser needs an update so you download malware.

optHideHint.message: Greys out "you've won a prize" blocks inside otherwise normal pages.

optTechscamHint.message: Detects fake "your PC is infected, call this number" pages and gives you a way out.

optClipboardHint.message: Warns when a site secretly puts a command or crypto address on your clipboard.

optShopHint.message: Looks for fake countdowns, fake "only 2 left" pressure, missing contact details and off-platform payment (Zelle/wire/crypto), and shows them in the popup.

optSerpHint.message: On Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo, flags a sponsored result whose ad goes somewhere other than the site it shows.

optWalletHint.message: Warns before you approve token spends, "Permit" signatures or account delegations that drainers abuse.

optLeakyFormHint.message: Warns when a site sends the email or phone you typed to a tracker before you press submit.

optFingerprintHint.message: Tells you which script is fingerprinting your device to track you across sites.

optNotifyHint.message: Flags the "click Allow to continue" trick sites use to spam you with pop-ups.

optStrictHint.message: For anyone who wants maximum caution: even "suspicious" pages are blocked with a full-screen warning and simpler wording. Best for helping a less confident family member stay safe.

optReportingHint.message: Sends the site name (never the full address or page text) and anonymous risk signals of pages flagged dangerous, and of sites you report. Off by default.

trustedLead.message: ScamShield stays quiet on these sites. Remove one to protect it again.

historyLead.message: Stored only on this device (site names, never full addresses).

feedLead.message: A daily-rebuilt list of known scam sites (OpenPhish + URLhaus, heavily filtered). ScamShield only downloads it.

backupHint.message: Save your settings and trusted sites to a file, or load them on another computer.

syncHint.message: Keep your settings and trusted sites in step on every browser where you're signed in. Uses your browser's own sync — ScamShield still has no account or server. Off by default.

bannerDangerBrand.message: Dangerous page — looks like $BRAND$, but isn't

interstitialHead1.message: Stop — this page is trying to scam you

interstitialHead2.message: Hold on — this looks like a scam page

interstitialReassure.message: Nothing you typed has been sent yet. Leaving now is safe.

techScamBody.message: This is a web page, not your computer — your computer is fine. Real security warnings never lock your screen or show a phone number. Do not call, and do not pay.

walletRiskyBody.message: If you did not expect this, cancel. Drainers use these requests to steal your crypto.

obLead.message: It watches the pages you visit and warns you about scams — entirely on your device. Your browsing never leaves your computer.

obPhishingBody.message: Warns when a page sends your password to the wrong site.

obBrandBody.message: Recognises a copied PayPal, bank or telco icon on a site that isn't theirs — 60+ brands, including UAE banks and government services.

obPageBody.message: Reads the wording and layout of login pages on your device to catch scams not yet on any list.

obWalletBody.message: Stops drainer approvals and recovery-phrase theft before your wallet sees them.

obClipboardBody.message: Alerts you when a site secretly copies a command to your clipboard.

obPopupsBody.message: Breaks the scary pop-up loop and helps you leave.

obPinBody.message: Click the puzzle-piece icon in your toolbar, then the pin next to ScamShield, so you can see each page's status at a glance.

obNote.message: ScamShield is free. Optional: in Settings you can help make it smarter by sharing anonymous reports of scams it catches — it's off unless you turn it on. If it helps you, you can support development from the Settings page.
